feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Concertgoer describes 'distressing scenes' after 'unknown substance' released
articles.summary: A concertgoer has described "really distressing scenes" after more than 12,000 people were evacuated from the UK's biggest arena when an "unknown substance" was released.

articles.title: Major trial to examine if AI can help detect breast cancer earlier
articles.summary: Hundreds of thousands of women taking part in the NHS breast cancer screening programme could have their scans assessed by AI to see if it leads to earlier diagnosis.

articles.title: Man charged with raping woman on Brighton beach
articles.summary: A 28-year-old man has been charged with raping a woman on Brighton beach in the summer.

articles.title: Suspect charged over death of man found injured in hospital car park
articles.summary: A suspect has been charged following the death of a young man who was found seriously injured in a hospital car park, almost 20 miles from where he was wounded.

articles.title: Britain's next fighter jet could be last with a pilot in the cockpit, says RAF chief
articles.summary: Britain's next fighter jet could be the last to fly with a pilot in the cockpit, according to the head of the RAF.

articles.title: Man charged with attempted murder after councillor stabbed in Bradford
articles.summary: A man has been charged with attempted murder after a councillor was stabbed while out door-knocking in Bradford.
